instruction: Request $13 publicly on Venmo from my friend, Stacy, with a note, "For yesterday's meal".
notes: Task is a pure state-change task (no answer), so supervisor-complete-task takes only the payment-request record parameter (not an API argument). The desired request is modeled as a payment-request object whose target person, amount, note and privacy are static init facts; venmo-create-payment-request requires the friend's email to have been discovered via venmo-search-friends (query 'Stacy'). The email object stacy-email is a runtime placeholder read from search_friends; email-of is a static link so the planner binds the right object. privacy-public corresponds to private=false. Every non-final action has (not (task-completed)) in its precondition; only supervisor-complete-task sets (task-completed). Goal: request created with amount 13, description 'For yesterday's meal', private=false, receiver = Stacy's Venmo user.

plan: (venmo-create-payment-request stacy-email amount-13 venmo-token note-for-yesterdays-meal privacy-public stacy request-stacy-13)
